reviews.scope: Text unchanged. Basis changed: the library policy now names the Baptist Faith and Message 2000 as the site's doctrinal standard (Westminster and the 1689 Baptist confession cited as historic Reformed confessions), and the Westminster, Craig and Augustine source notes were reworded to match. All text fields were searched for claims about the doctrinal standard (Westminster, Reformed, confession, 'our' and 'this library' wording) and each match was read in context.
reviews.note: No claim in this document presents Westminster or the Reformed tradition as the site's own standard; no text change needed. AI-assisted editorial review; not independent human theological approval.
